description: Ordered, fully expanded third-overlay corrections against immutable effective-completion v2 resolution inputs. No placeholders; exact before values and canonical hashes.

production.statement: No src/, evaluator output, parent implementation, build, test, lint, formatter, or browser run consulted.

mergedPreservation.note: Resolution-only patches; publication worksheet untouched. validationOwner corrections are semantic owner fields, not status rewrites.

patches.reason: Define evidenceRef/validationOwner/observerWitness roots as exact observation associations; no inferred trust or ownership.

evidenceRefs.meaning: Exact input or observation association. A ref does not by itself assert authentication, checker invocation, trust, validity, or ownership.

validationOwner.meaning: Strict owner of the authenticated disposition.
validationOwner.null: No authenticated owner. null is not interchangeable with any string and is never inferred from evidenceRefs, catalog availability, producer labels, or observerWitness.owner.
rules: Do not infer from raw-record availability.

observerWitness.meaning: Records an actual observer or failed attempt without transferring authenticated ownership.

authoritySideParameter.meaning: Authority-local parameter inspection. It is not resolver receipt and not validator evidence.

patches.reason: Define chain target separately from leaf-signature key availability.

value.chainEstablished: Authenticated path from a configured trust anchor to the target zone DNSKEY RRset named by the checkpoint.
value.chainTarget: The DNSKEY RRset at the target zone, not every key needed for a particular leaf RRset RRSIG.
value.leafSignatureKeyAvailable: Separate boolean. False means the selected leaf RRSIG key is absent or ineligible; it is not a chain failure.
value.rule: Never collapse a missing leaf ZSK into chainEstablished=false when the parent DS and child DNSKEY RRset are authenticated.
